dominant_strengths: Native macOS design language perfectly executed with proper blur effects and system-consistent controls
Clear information hierarchy separating appearance and behavior sections with appropriate typography weights
Minimal interface focuses attention on essential settings without unnecessary decoration or complexity
dominant_weaknesses: Generic system template lacks any brand personality or distinctive visual identity for Alcove app
Toggle-heavy interface creates monotonous rhythm without varied interaction patterns or visual interest
Dark theme implementation feels incomplete with insufficient contrast between UI layers and backgrounds
fix_priorities: Add subtle brand accent color to active toggles instead of generic system green
Increase background panel contrast from #1C1C1E to #242426 for better depth perception
Introduce varied control types (sliders, segmented controls) to break toggle monotony
Add contextual help text under complex settings like 'Focus Mode Sync'
rationale.norman_balance: Strong behavioral design (clear controls, good affordances) outweighs modest visceral appeal and limited reflective brand connection.
rationale.intent_fit: Successfully delivers a functional settings panel but misses opportunity to elevate beyond standard system preferences aesthetic.
